decisions.reason: The source preserves the second V's left-arm relationship to the E and L and changes only the V-system right-arm reach and terminal nuances; the E and L requirement remains unchanged.
A same-message MODIFY already records the Option B terminal basis, subtle right-arm reach increase, geometry preservation, and terminal-softness constraint for the second V.
A same-message MODIFY already captures the selected Option B terminal, extremely subtle reach increase, preserved slope and broad geometry, and optional corner softening.
A same-message MODIFY already applies the Option B terminal and identical reach refinement to the É accent while preserving literal derivation and the straight-tip softness constraint.
The source changes right-arm reach and terminal treatment without changing the shared baseline or the lower-point alignment of the letterforms.
A same-message MODIFY already records that broad architecture and all unlisted decisions remain locked while only the specified reach and terminal nuances are varied.
A same-message MODIFY already captures the three requested variations, comparison dimensions, horizontal reference guide, and constraint to keep all other variables unchanged.
The source explicitly keeps everything else unchanged, so the selected Option 2 Balanced Flow kerning remains valid without modification.
Applying the same reach refinement to the Hero V and É accent does not alter their required common peak alignment; the source does not establish a new alignment rule.
The geometric reach and terminal refinements do not change which wordmark elements receive champagne gold or which elements remain black.
The source requests geometric refinements while keeping other decisions unchanged and does not replace or modify the selected Satin Reflection finish.
The source specifies design variations but does not change the standing requirement to provide a short rationale for each design round.
